claim: Taiga presented as free and open-source agile project management tool; Self hosted option
Docker is the easiest and recommended way to run Taiga in production; Docker >= 19.03.0
Basic configuration in .env: database, URL scheme and domain, secret key; strongly recommended to change defaults
Source install documents PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ, backend, frontend and events setup
Familiarity with Docker, docker compose and Docker repositories needed
Patches licensed under MPL 2.0; support via community and issue trackers
Site frames Taiga around planning, team interaction (stand-ups) and insight; no goals or portfolio feature described
